description: Use this when someone wants the data sheet or another document of a named product and has a product name, brand, article number, GTIN/EAN or UFI, e.g. "Find the current SDS for Silikon Neutral" or "safety data sheet for EAN 9006543210017". Searches the public products of checked manufacturers on ProofPass by name, article number, GTIN/EAN or UFI, optionally within one manufacturer. Returns up to 20 products with manufacturer, identifiers, available document kinds and the product page URL. / Sucht öffentliche Produkte geprüfter Hersteller nach Name, Artikelnummer, GTIN oder UFI. Do not use for a QR link or ProofPass address (use resolve_product), for the person's own products that are not public (use list_my_products), or to judge whether a substance is hazardous. Only manufacturers that publish on ProofPass are found; an empty result says nothing about the product elsewhere.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

limit.description: At most this many results, 1 to 20. Default 10

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer slug to search within (the part after /hersteller/ in the address)

query.description: Product name, article number, GTIN/EAN or UFI, e.g. "Silikon Neutral" or "9006543210017"

name: search_products
title: Search products with data sheets
